A little about us

Good hair is self-care.

Fica Braids has been in business for 3 years, with 6+ years of braiding experience. With two braiders and a cozy home salon in Downtown Toronto, our goal is simple: help you feel confident, comfortable and beautiful with a style that lasts.

Pick your style
